text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Ngh, haah...! What on earth was that just 
now?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
They say the feelings and wishes of 
Umamusume dwell within the Three 
Goddesses' statue... Could this be what 
they meant?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...The sentiments from all our 
predecessors have been received without 
fail. Let us carve out victory and 
continue to prove our title as 'the 
strongest.'"
